definitions.explanation: A fully built and furnished house that a builder opens to visitors so that buyers can see a design before ordering one. In Japan many are grouped together at a {住宅展示場|じゅうたくてんじじょう} (housing exhibition park).

examples.japanese: モデルハウス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To look around a model home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧モデルハウス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Our family went to see some show houses at the weekend.

examples.japanese: モデルハウス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: Model homes have luxurious furniture and fittings, so they can look quite different from the house you actually build.

notes:
A made-in-Japan compound of English "model" and "house".

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- モデルハウス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tour a model home
- {住宅展示場|じゅうたくてんじじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧モデルハウス: a model home at a housing exhibition park

SIMILAR WORDS:
- モデルルーム: a show flat — a furnished sample apartment, used for condominiums rather than detached houses
